summary: Bitterroot National Forest cupola cabin: camp from 1921, cabin built 1928, destroyed or removed in 1966. A climbing guide describes remains on the summit.

facts.design: cupola cabin, built 1928 (site a camp from 1921)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1966 (firelookout.com); removed in 1966 (Rex's page). A climbing guide describes what appear to be remains on the summit.

access.note: Hike from Little Boulder Creek trailhead via FR 1130; motor vehicles barred Oct 15 to Dec 1. No closure stated (SummitPost).

visit.trail_note: Little Boulder Creek trailhead, reached by the West Fork Road to Painted Rocks Lake and FR 1130 (SummitPost).

events.note: firelookout.com says destroyed; Rex's Forest Lookouts page says Removed

evidence.quote: Established as a camp in 1921, this cupola cabin, built in 1928, was destroyed in 1966.

evidence.supports: Rex's page lists the site as removed in 1966
Piquett Mountain is in a portion of the Bitterroot National Forest
evidence.quote: Piquett Mountain is in a portion of the Bitterroot National Forest

evidence.supports: about 5 miles east-northeast of Painted Rocks Lake
evidence.quote: about 5 miles east-northeast of Painted Rocks Lake

evidence.supports: summit has remains of what appears to be an old fire lookout
evidence.quote: The Piquett Mountain summit has the remains of what appears to be an old fire lookout.

evidence.supports: list of remains: bed springs, nails, bolts, lightning grounding wire, melted glass
evidence.quote: Various artifacts, including bed springs, nails, assorted bolts and fasteners, grounding wires for the control of lightning strikes, and plenty of melted glass are all that remain.
There is also a hitching post for stock animals

evidence.supports: route: West Fork Road to Painted Rocks Lake
evidence.quote: Follow the West Fork Road to Painted Rocks Lake

evidence.supports: FR 1130 along Little Boulder Creek to trailhead
seasonal ban on motor vehicles Oct 15 to Dec 1
evidence.quote: Between October 15 and December 1, no motorized vehicles of any sort are allowed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both sources date the end to 1966. firelookout.com says destroyed; Rex's Forest Lookouts page says Removed. The story reports both words.

sources.title: Piquett Mountain - Forest Lookouts (Rex's Fire Lookout Page)

notes_for_editor: Dates and fate come from two lookout pages that agree on 1966 but differ on destroyed vs removed. Remains and access come from one SummitPost climbing page, not a survey; access is marked public because it is National Forest land with a described trailhead and no closure stated. No staffing source found. The brief record (gone, ground, Bitterroot NF) is consistent with sources; no corrections.
